REQ1 and IAM/control-plane interfaces are already assigned.

actualSourceEvidence.fact: WorkerLease has only workerId,leaseId,expiresAt,allowedCapabilities; no operational credential or BearerAuth binding.
registerWorker requires worker.bootstrap; heartbeatWorker separately requires worker.self.

frozenBasis.fact: Registration returns short-lived credentials and allowed capabilities.
Control plane returns short-lived token and permitted capabilities.

findings.minimumFix: Dedicated scoped short-lived WorkerCredential in registration/renewal response with explicit token type, token, worker/lease/audience/expiry/capability bindings. Heartbeat must verify current lease binding; renewal rotates/revokes prior token; idempotent replay never issues fresh credentials for expired lease/token. Preserve no-store and synthetic nonfunctional fixtures.

Add non-operation-reachable Replica/RetentionHold removal/required/enum regressions. No need to restore deferred REQ6 operations.

Keep normal release request semantics unchanged.
